note: Registry data could not be verified. All 10 permitted tool calls were used: DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused), Bing returned only irrelevant results for the 'K2' token (mountaineering/vitamin/ski pages) and ignored the quoted company name, and every registry aggregator attempted (zaubacorp.com company page and search, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com) returned HTTP 403/404. Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status and audited revenue for FY25/FY26 are all null - not public via accessible sources in this session, and not invented. No rejection applied: absence of accessible records is NOT evidence that the entity does not exist, is struck off, liquidated or bankrupt, so the company is retained with role 'unknown'. Declared HS 843149 (parts of lifting/handling machinery) is plausible for a crane-components business but is not a registry matter and was not used as a rejection ground per project rules. Recommended next step: manual MCA master-data lookup by exact name and, if available, the GSTIN printed on the supplier's invoice, to confirm legal name, CIN, state of registration and GST status.
